blocks.zh: Part II：查驗執行
blocks.en: Part II: Inspection Execution

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握遠端查驗期間即時互動（real-time interactions）的最佳實務，包含視訊平台設定、會議紀律與問題記錄
blocks.en: Master best practices for real-time interactions during a remote inspection, including video platform setup, meeting discipline and question logging

blocks.zh: 了解多工作流（multiple workstreams）管理策略，確保不同查驗官同時作業時資訊不重複、不遺漏
blocks.en: Understand strategies for managing multiple workstreams so that information is neither duplicated nor missed when several inspectors work at the same time

blocks.zh: 釐清查驗官要求直接存取 GMP/GDP 系統時的正確回應方式，區分「拒絕存取」與「拒絕接受查驗」的差異
blocks.en: Clarify the correct response when an inspector asks for direct access to GMP/GDP systems, and distinguish between "declining access" and "refusing to be inspected"

blocks.zh: 建立文件索取請求（responding to requests）、稽核報告分享（sharing audit reports）、樣品採集（sample collection）與每日收尾會議（daily wrap-up）的標準作業流程
blocks.en: Establish standard procedures for responding to requests, sharing audit reports, sample collection and the daily wrap-up

blocks.zh: Topic A.1 — Use of Real-Time Interactions（即時互動的運用）
blocks.en: Topic A.1 - Use of Real-Time Interactions

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 單一會議連結 vs. 分段連結
blocks.en: Core Concept - One Meeting Link vs. Segmented Links

blocks.zh: 一日一連結（One Full-Day Link）策略的邏輯：查驗過程中，查驗官隨時可能要求轉換主題、等待文件或提問後離席。若每個子題各建立一個會議連結，人員反覆收到新連結邀請、進出會議，不僅耗費時間，也增加混亂風險。
blocks.en: The logic of the One Full-Day Link strategy: during an inspection, the inspector may switch topics, wait for documents or step away after asking a question at any moment. If a separate meeting link is created for each sub-topic, staff repeatedly receive new invitations and leave and join meetings, which wastes time and increases the risk of confusion.

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 建議：為整個查驗日建立一個持久性連結，所有人員「進出自如」（leave and rejoin freely），但每次加入時必須自我介紹（attendees should always be introduced upon joining）。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote recommends creating one persistent link for the whole inspection day. All personnel may leave and rejoin freely, but attendees should always be introduced upon joining.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 而言尤其重要——當天可能需要品保、生產、QC、法規等多部門 SME 輪流支援，單一連結讓調度更有彈性。
blocks.en: This matters especially for a CDMO: on any given day SMEs from QA, production, QC and regulatory affairs may need to support in turn, and a single link makes deployment more flexible.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 虛擬候診室如同醫院掛號台
blocks.en: Analogy - The Virtual Waiting Room Is Like a Hospital Registration Desk

blocks.zh: 想像醫院急診候診區：護理師（指定等候室監控人員）管控誰進入診間（虛擬會議室），確保只有被叫號的人進入，避免診間同時湧入過多人員造成混亂。
blocks.en: Picture a hospital emergency waiting area: a nurse (the designated waiting-room monitor) controls who enters the consulting room (the virtual meeting room), so that only the person whose number has been called goes in and the room is not flooded with too many people at once.

blocks.zh: Virtual Waiting Room（虛擬候診室）就是這個概念——現場 SME 待命在候診室，由指定人員判斷時機再讓他們進入查驗主會場。這樣查驗官面對的永遠是組織有序、目的明確的人員，而非隨機進出的雜亂畫面。
blocks.en: The Virtual Waiting Room works the same way: on-site SMEs stand by in the waiting room, and a designated person decides when to admit them to the main inspection session. The inspector therefore always faces an organized group with a clear purpose, not a random stream of people coming and going.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 虛擬會議紀律是查驗態度的延伸
blocks.en: Key Point - Virtual Meeting Discipline Is an Extension of Inspection Attitude

blocks.zh: 許多公司誤以為「線上查驗比現場查驗輕鬆」，忽視虛擬會議紀律。PDA PtC-Remote 明確指出，這是查驗失敗的常見原因之一。以下是必須事先訓練的兩大紀律：
blocks.en: Many companies wrongly assume that "an online inspection is easier than an on-site one" and neglect virtual meeting discipline. PDA PtC-Remote explicitly identifies this as one of the common causes of a failed inspection. The two disciplines below must be trained in advance:

blocks.zh: 鏡頭前紀律（On-Camera Discipline）：著裝整齊（相當於現場查驗的工廠制服要求）、背景乾淨、攝影機保持開啟。家人闖入鏡頭、邊吃飯邊開會，在查驗官眼中等同於對查驗不尊重。
blocks.en: On-Camera Discipline: dress neatly (equivalent to the gowning or uniform requirements of an on-site inspection), keep the background clean and keep the camera on. Family members walking into frame or eating during the meeting are seen by the inspector as disrespect for the inspection.

blocks.zh: 麥克風紀律（Microphone Discipline）：不發言時靜音，避免迴音（feedback loop）——迴音通常由同一人在多裝置同時登入所致。若需靜音他人麥克風，務必事先告知，避免造成誤解。
blocks.en: Microphone Discipline: mute when not speaking and avoid feedback loops, which are usually caused by the same person being logged in on several devices at once. If someone else's microphone needs to be muted, tell them beforehand to avoid misunderstanding.

blocks.zh: 建議查驗前一週進行全員模擬演練（mock inspection），熟悉工具並演練紀律。
blocks.en: We recommend a full-team mock inspection one week before the inspection to become familiar with the tools and practice the discipline.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼每日使用單一會議連結比每個子題各建一個連結更有效率？請從管理複雜度與人員調度兩個角度回答。
blocks.en: Why is using a single meeting link per day more efficient than creating one link for each sub-topic? Answer from the two perspectives of management complexity and staff deployment.

blocks.zh: 查驗官透過 WhatsApp 私訊詢問某份文件的具體頁碼，現場同仁應該如何回應？為什麼不能直接在 WhatsApp 上答覆？
blocks.en: An inspector sends a private WhatsApp message asking for the specific page number of a document. How should on-site staff respond, and why must they not simply answer on WhatsApp?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 問題記錄（Question Log）的建立與管理
blocks.en: Practical Application - Setting Up and Managing the Question Log

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 要求記錄所有查驗官問題，包含口頭即時提問與書面訊息中的請求。以下是建議的問題記錄框架：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote requires that all inspector questions be recorded, including verbal real-time questions and requests in written messages. The suggested question log framework is as follows:

blocks.zh: 此 log 應即時共享給所有 Remote Inspection Host，並在每日收尾會議中逐項確認未結事項。問題 log 同時是查驗結束後內部檢討的重要依據。
blocks.en: This log should be shared with all Remote Inspection Hosts in real time, and open items should be confirmed one by one at the daily wrap-up. The question log is also an important basis for the internal review after the inspection ends.

blocks.zh: Topic B.1 — Managing Multiple Workstreams（多工作流管理）
blocks.en: Topic B.1 - Managing Multiple Workstreams

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 多工作流如同醫院各科同時查房
blocks.en: Analogy - Multiple Workstreams Are Like Several Hospital Wards Being Audited at Once

blocks.zh: 想像一家醫院同時接受三組衛生稽查人員分別查房：一組查內科、一組查外科、一組查藥局。如果沒有一位院長級統籌協調者，三組人同時向護理站調取同一份病歷紀錄，就會造成混亂與資料重複。
blocks.en: Imagine a hospital that receives three health inspection teams at the same time: one reviews internal medicine, one surgery and one the pharmacy. Without a director-level coordinator, all three teams would pull the same patient record from the nursing station simultaneously, causing confusion and duplicated information.

blocks.zh: 遠端查驗的 Remote Inspection Host（遠端查驗主持人） 就是這位院長——統籌協調各工作流，確保文件請求不重複、資訊不遺漏，也確保不同查驗官之間的議程進度保持平衡。
blocks.en: The Remote Inspection Host in a remote inspection is that director: coordinating the workstreams, ensuring that document requests are not duplicated and information is not missed, and keeping the agenda progress of the different inspectors balanced.

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：現場查驗時，查驗官親眼可見彼此的行動；遠端查驗中，各工作流各自運作，唯有集中問題記錄（centralized question log）才能確保全局可視性。
blocks.en: Key difference: in an on-site inspection, inspectors can see each other's activities; in a remote inspection each workstream runs on its own, so only a centralized question log gives full visibility.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Remote Inspection Host 的角色定義
blocks.en: Core Concept - Defining the Role of the Remote Inspection Host

blocks.zh: Remote Inspection Host（遠端查驗主持人） 是 PDA PtC-Remote 引入的特定角色，與現場查驗的「接待人員」不完全相同。其核心職責包含：
blocks.en: The Remote Inspection Host is a specific role introduced by PDA PtC-Remote and is not identical to the "escort" or "guide" in an on-site inspection. Core responsibilities include:

blocks.zh: 為負責的查驗官獨立管理一個工作流（含獨立的視訊連結或分組討論室）
blocks.en: Independently managing one workstream for the assigned inspector (including a separate video link or breakout room)

blocks.zh: 即時更新並維護共用問題記錄（question log）
blocks.en: Updating and maintaining the shared question log in real time

blocks.zh: 協調文件分享平台上的跨工作流文件可視性
blocks.en: Coordinating cross-workstream document visibility on the document-sharing platform

blocks.zh: 向首席查驗主持人（Lead Remote Inspection Host）報告工作流進度
blocks.en: Reporting workstream progress to the Lead Remote Inspection Host

blocks.zh: 建議公司為每位預計同時作業的查驗官配置一位專屬 Remote Inspection Host，並在查驗前進行角色演練。
blocks.en: We recommend assigning one dedicated Remote Inspection Host to each inspector expected to work concurrently, and rehearsing the roles before the inspection.

blocks.zh: 若 Inspector A 和 Inspector B 同時各自要求同一份 SOPs 清單，沒有集中問題記錄的情況下會發生什麼問題？集中問題記錄如何解決這個問題？
blocks.en: If Inspector A and Inspector B each request the same list of SOPs at the same time, what problems occur without a centralized question log? How does a centralized question log solve them?

blocks.zh: 你的公司正在接受虛擬查驗，共有 2 位查驗官同時作業。請描述你會如何設定會議結構（連結數量、角色分配、問題記錄工具）。
blocks.en: Your company is undergoing a virtual inspection with 2 inspectors working at the same time. Describe how you would set up the meeting structure (number of links, role assignment, question log tool).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 多工作流連結分配表（2–3 位查驗官情境）
blocks.en: Practical Application - Link and Role Allocation Table (2-3 Inspector Scenario)

blocks.zh: 以下為 3 位查驗官同時查驗的連結與角色分配範例：
blocks.en: The following is an example of link and role allocation when 3 inspectors work at the same time:

blocks.zh: 所有工作流共用同一個問題記錄（question log），Lead Host 在每小時整合一次各工作流進度，確保文件請求無重複且即時回應。
blocks.en: All workstreams share one question log. The Lead Host consolidates the progress of each workstream every hour to make sure document requests are not duplicated and are answered promptly.

blocks.zh: Topic C.1 — Inspector Access to Systems（查驗官存取系統）
blocks.en: Topic C.1 - Inspector Access to Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 為什麼不允許查驗官直接存取 GMP 系統
blocks.en: Core Concept - Why Inspectors Are Not Allowed Direct Access to GMP Systems

blocks.zh: 這是一個常見誤解：公司擔心拒絕查驗官直接登入系統會被視為隱瞞。PDA PtC-Remote 明確澄清：
blocks.en: This is a common misunderstanding: companies worry that refusing to let inspectors log in to systems directly will be seen as concealment. PDA PtC-Remote clarifies explicitly:

blocks.zh: 拒絕直接存取的理由是資料完整性（Data Integrity）保護，而非隱瞞。外部人員若未經訓練直接操作 LIMS、BMS 或 ERP 等 GMP 系統，可能：
blocks.en: The reason for refusing direct access is the protection of data integrity, not concealment. If untrained external personnel operate GMP systems such as LIMS, BMS or ERP directly, they could:

blocks.zh: 意外觸發未授權的系統事件（untriggered data creation）
blocks.en: Accidentally trigger unauthorized system events (untriggered data creation)

blocks.zh: 修改或覆寫正在進行中的記錄
blocks.en: Modify or overwrite records that are in progress

blocks.zh: 產生不符合審計軌跡（audit trail）要求的資料條目
blocks.en: Generate data entries that do not meet audit trail requirements

blocks.zh: 違反 21 CFR Part 11 或 EU GMP Annex 11 的電子記錄規範
blocks.en: Violate the electronic record requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 or EU GMP Annex 11

blocks.zh: 正確做法：由受過訓練的站點專家（expert site personnel）登入系統，透過螢幕共享（screen-sharing）讓查驗官完整觀看，並可直接指示專家導航至任何畫面或資料。查驗官的可視性（visibility）不受任何限制。
blocks.en: Correct approach: trained expert site personnel log in to the system and share their screen so the inspector can see everything, and the inspector can direct the expert to navigate to any screen or data. The inspector's visibility is not restricted in any way.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 準備好口頭說明：「拒絕直接存取 ≠ 拒絕查驗」
blocks.en: Key Point - Prepare the Verbal Explanation: "Declining Direct Access ≠ Refusing the Inspection"

blocks.zh: 查驗官在現場要求直接登入時，現場人員往往因緊張而語無倫次。建議事先準備標準說明（standard script），例如：
blocks.en: When an inspector asks for direct login during the inspection, on-site staff often become nervous and incoherent. We recommend preparing a standard script in advance, for example:

blocks.zh: 此說明同步傳達三個訊息：(1) 我們願意完全透明；(2) 限制直接存取是 GMP 合規要求，非敵意；(3) 查驗官的可視性（visibility）不受限。
blocks.en: This statement conveys three messages at once: (1) we are willing to be fully transparent; (2) restricting direct access is a GMP compliance requirement, not hostility; (3) the inspector's visibility is not limited.

blocks.zh: 查驗前，Remote Inspection Host 應完成此說明的演練，避免臨場失措。
blocks.en: Before the inspection, the Remote Inspection Host should rehearse this statement to avoid being caught off guard.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 螢幕共享代理操作（Screen-Share Proxy）標準流程
blocks.en: Practical Application - Standard Procedure for Screen-Share Proxy Operation

blocks.zh: 以下為 LIMS 系統存取的正確操作流程：
blocks.en: The following is the correct procedure for LIMS access:

blocks.zh: 準備階段（查驗前）：指定各系統的「代理操作員（proxy operator）」——通常為系統管理員或資深使用者，確保其熟悉系統導航且有權限存取查驗範圍內的所有模組
blocks.en: Preparation (before the inspection): designate a "proxy operator" for each system, usually a system administrator or senior user, who is familiar with system navigation and has access to all modules within the inspection scope

blocks.zh: 查驗官提出請求：「請顯示批次 2024001 的環境監測趨勢圖」
blocks.en: Inspector makes a request: "Please show the environmental monitoring trend chart for batch 2024001"

blocks.zh: Host 轉達請求：透過內部 chat 通知 QC 系統操作員
blocks.en: Host relays the request: notifies the QC system operator through internal chat

blocks.zh: 操作員登入並共享螢幕：開啟螢幕共享，導航至指定位置，並口頭確認「查驗官，這是您要求的環境監測趨勢圖，涵蓋 2023/01–2024/01 期間，地點為 Grade A 充填間」
blocks.en: Operator logs in and shares the screen: starts screen sharing, navigates to the requested location and confirms verbally, "Inspector, this is the environmental monitoring trend chart you requested, covering January 2023 to January 2024 for the Grade A filling room"

blocks.zh: 查驗官指示後續：可要求深入任何子頁面、匯出特定資料或顯示原始審計軌跡
blocks.en: Inspector gives follow-up instructions: may ask to drill down into any sub-page, export specific data or display the raw audit trail

blocks.zh: 記錄：所有系統存取請求記入問題記錄（question log），含時間、查驗官、請求內容、操作員姓名
blocks.en: Record: all system access requests are entered in the question log, including time, inspector, request content and operator name

blocks.zh: 查驗官堅持要親自操作 LIMS 鍵盤，理由是「我在其他工廠都可以直接操作，你們不讓我操作代表有問題」。你應該如何回應？
blocks.en: An inspector insists on operating the LIMS keyboard personally, saying, "I can operate directly at other sites; if you don't let me, there must be a problem." How should you respond?

blocks.zh: 若查驗官要求查看的 LIMS 資料超出螢幕共享時可顯示的範圍（例如需要匯出 PDF），操作員應如何處理，才能在確保資料完整性的同時滿足查驗需求？
blocks.en: If the LIMS data the inspector asks to see goes beyond what screen sharing can display (for example, a PDF export is needed), how should the operator handle it so as to satisfy the inspection need while protecting data integrity?

blocks.zh: Topic D.1 — Responding to Requests（回應查驗官索取請求）
blocks.en: Topic D.1 - Responding to Requests

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 需要法務介入的請求類別（重要檢查清單）
blocks.en: Key Point - Request Categories That Require Legal Involvement (Important Checklist)

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 特別點名三類在遠端查驗中需提前備好法務策略的請求：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote specifically names three categories of requests for which a legal strategy should be prepared in advance for remote inspections:

blocks.zh: 人員影像/錄影請求（Video/Photos of Personnel）：即使無法辨識個人身份，在許多國家（尤其歐盟 GDPR、台灣個資法），拍攝工作人員仍需取得授權。查驗前應與法務確認公司立場。
blocks.en: Video/Photos of Personnel: even if individuals cannot be identified, in many countries (particularly under the EU GDPR and Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act) filming staff still requires authorization. Confirm the company's position with Legal before the inspection.

blocks.zh: 查驗官錄影/截圖請求（Inspector Recording）：查驗官若要求錄製視訊通話或截圖，公司有權要求說明用途並限制條件。未經協議不可自動同意。
blocks.en: Inspector Recording: if the inspector asks to record the video call or take screenshots, the company has the right to ask about the purpose and to limit the conditions. Do not agree automatically without an agreement.

blocks.zh: 公司認為必須拒絕的任何請求（Any Request Site Must Decline）：例如要求提供競爭對手客戶資訊、超出查驗範圍的商業機密文件等。應預先演練拒絕的措辭，避免現場慌張而做出非必要的讓步。
blocks.en: Any Request Site Must Decline: for example, requests for competitors' customer information or confidential business documents outside the inspection scope. Rehearse the wording of refusals in advance so that staff do not panic on the spot and make unnecessary concessions.

blocks.zh: 行動建議：查驗前舉行「法務情景模擬（legal scenario walkthrough）」，讓 Remote Inspection Host 熟悉各類請求的標準回應程序。
blocks.en: Recommended action: hold a "legal scenario walkthrough" before the inspection so that the Remote Inspection Hosts are familiar with the standard response procedure for each type of request.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 回應時間框架的設定原則
blocks.en: Core Concept - Principles for Setting Response Timeframes

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 指出回應速度應「盡快，且符合現場運作現實」。這不是一個絕對數字，而是需要主動溝通管理的動態承諾。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote states that responses should be provided "as soon as possible, consistent with the realities of site operations." This is not an absolute number but a dynamic commitment that must be actively managed through communication.

blocks.zh: 影響回應時間的因素：
blocks.en: Factors affecting response time:

blocks.zh: 文件是否為電子格式或紙本（紙本需掃描或拍照）
blocks.en: Whether the document is electronic or paper (paper needs scanning or photographing)

blocks.zh: 文件是否需要翻譯（繁中→英文）
blocks.en: Whether the document needs translation (Traditional Chinese to English)

blocks.zh: 相關 SME 是否在場或處於遠端工作狀態
blocks.en: Whether the relevant SME is on site or working remotely

blocks.zh: 文件是否屬於封存資料（archived documents）
blocks.en: Whether the document is an archived document

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：主動溝通預期延遲（communicate proactively）遠比沉默更重要。告知查驗官「此文件需要 2 小時取得，因為需要從紙本掃描」，遠比等到逾時才說明更能維持查驗信任度。
blocks.en: Key principle: communicate proactively about expected delays, which is far more important than silence. Telling the inspector "this document will take 2 hours to retrieve because it needs to be scanned from paper" maintains inspection trust far better than explaining only after the deadline has passed.

blocks.zh: 查驗官要求錄製本次視訊查驗的全程，理由是為了「方便事後核對查驗記錄」。你的公司應如何回應？哪些步驟是必要的？
blocks.en: An inspector asks to record the entire video inspection "to make it easier to check the inspection record afterwards." How should your company respond? Which steps are necessary?

blocks.zh: 某份被索取的批次記錄存放於紙本封存室，取出、掃描並傳送需要 3 小時。你應該立即告知查驗官，還是先嘗試取得後再說明延遲原因？兩種做法的利弊各是什麼？
blocks.en: A requested batch record is stored in the paper archive room, and retrieving, scanning and sending it will take 3 hours. Should you tell the inspector immediately, or first try to obtain it and explain the delay afterwards? What are the pros and cons of each approach?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 請求分流（Request Triage）三級回應系統
blocks.en: Practical Application - Three-Level Request Triage System

blocks.zh: 建議公司建立三級請求分流機制：
blocks.en: We recommend that companies establish a three-level request triage mechanism:

blocks.zh: 每個回應等級的分類標準和溝通措辭應在查驗前訓練完成，Remote Inspection Host 可在不需升報的情況下自主判斷回應等級。
blocks.en: The classification criteria and communication wording for each response level should be trained before the inspection, so that the Remote Inspection Host can determine the response level independently without escalation.

blocks.zh: Topic D.2 — Sharing Audit Reports（分享稽核報告）
blocks.en: Topic D.2 - Sharing Audit Reports

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CMO/供應商稽核報告分享標準流程
blocks.en: Practical Application - Standard Procedure for Sharing CMO/Supplier Audit Reports

blocks.zh: 當查驗官要求分享 CMO 稽核報告時，建議遵循以下分階段流程：
blocks.en: When an inspector asks to see a CMO audit report, we recommend following this staged process:

blocks.zh:
第一步：確認分享範圍
先顯示報告封面頁（執行日期、稽核範圍）及稽核結論摘要（overall audit outcome），透過螢幕共享（screen-sharing）或文件攝影機（document camera）呈現
blocks.en:
Step 1: Confirm the scope of sharing
First show the report cover page (date of execution, audit scope) and the summary of the overall audit outcome, presented through screen-sharing or a document camera

blocks.zh: 第二步：評估完整報告請求
blocks.en: Step 2: Assess the request for the full report

blocks.zh: 若查驗官要求完整報告，先暫緩並確認：
blocks.en: If the inspector asks for the full report, pause first and confirm:

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）是否有分享條款？
blocks.en: Does the Quality Agreement contain a sharing clause?

blocks.zh: 是否涉及保密協議（NDA）或不揭露條款？
blocks.en: Is a confidentiality agreement (NDA) or non-disclosure clause involved?

blocks.zh: 是否需要法務確認？
blocks.en: Is confirmation from Legal needed?

blocks.zh:
第三步：通知 CMO/供應商
在分享前或同時通知對方——這是 PDA PtC-Remote 指定的最佳實務（best practice）。可發送簡短電子郵件：「本公司正在接受 [衛生主管機關] 遠端查驗，查驗官已要求查閱貴公司稽核報告，我們將依品質協議第 X 條分享 [年份] 稽核報告。」
blocks.en:
Step 3: Notify the CMO/supplier
Notify them before or at the same time as sharing; this is the best practice specified by PDA PtC-Remote. A short email can be sent: "Our company is undergoing a remote inspection by [health authority], and the inspector has asked to review your company's audit report. We will share the [year] audit report in accordance with Clause X of the Quality Agreement."

blocks.zh:
第四步：記錄分享行為
在問題記錄（question log）中記載「分享了哪份報告、哪些內容、何時分享、通知 CMO/供應商的時間戳記」
blocks.en:
Step 4: Record the sharing
In the question log, record which report was shared, which content, when it was shared, and the timestamp of the notification to the CMO/supplier

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 更新未來品質協議的分享條款
blocks.en: Key Point - Update the Sharing Clauses in Future Quality Agreements

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 明確建議：未來所有與 CMO/供應商簽訂的品質協議（Quality Agreement）都應加入稽核報告分享條款。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote explicitly recommends: all future Quality Agreements with CMOs/suppliers should include an audit report sharing clause.

blocks.zh: 建議納入的條款要素：
blocks.en: Suggested clause elements:

blocks.zh: 允許在法規查驗情境下分享報告的授權語言
blocks.en: Authorizing language permitting reports to be shared in the context of regulatory inspections

blocks.zh: 分享前或分享時通知對方的時限（例如：「分享後 24 小時內通知」）
blocks.en: Time limit for notifying the other party before or at the time of sharing (for example, "notify within 24 hours after sharing")

blocks.zh: 明定可分享的範圍（摘要 vs. 完整報告 vs. 僅封面與結論）
blocks.en: A definition of what may be shared (summary vs. full report vs. cover page and conclusions only)

blocks.zh: 例外情況的處理程序（例如：涉及重大缺失的報告）
blocks.en: Procedure for handling exceptions (for example, reports involving critical findings)

blocks.zh: 如果現有協議缺乏此條款，查驗前應進行差距分析（gap assessment），識別哪些重要 CMO/供應商的協議需要優先更新。
blocks.en: If existing agreements lack this clause, a gap assessment should be performed before the inspection to identify which important CMO/supplier agreements need to be updated first.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 稽核報告分享如同醫師轉診病歷
blocks.en: Analogy - Sharing an Audit Report Is Like a Doctor Transferring Medical Records

blocks.zh: 當主治醫師（查驗官）要求調閱其他醫院（CMO）的就診記錄（稽核報告）時，轉介醫院（被查驗公司）必須先確認：病患（CMO）是否知情並同意、是否有轉診授權書（品質協議分享條款），才能釋出記錄。
blocks.en: When the attending physician (the inspector) asks to retrieve the treatment records (audit report) from another hospital (the CMO), the referring hospital (the inspected company) must first confirm that the patient (the CMO) knows and consents and that there is a referral authorization (the Quality Agreement sharing clause) before releasing the records.

blocks.zh: 直接提交完整報告而未事先告知 CMO，就像未經病患同意轉發病歷——即使出發點是配合查驗，仍可能違反保密協議，引發與 CMO 的法律糾紛。
blocks.en: Submitting the full report directly without notifying the CMO beforehand is like forwarding medical records without the patient's consent: even if the intention is to cooperate with the inspection, it may still breach the confidentiality agreement and lead to legal disputes with the CMO.

blocks.zh: 查驗官要求完整查閱貴公司某重要 CMO 的最近一次稽核報告，但品質協議中沒有分享條款。你應如何處理這個請求？
blocks.en: An inspector asks to review the most recent audit report of one of your important CMOs in full, but the Quality Agreement has no sharing clause. How should you handle this request?

blocks.zh: 在遠端查驗中，為什麼查驗官更可能要求分享 CMO 稽核報告（相比現場查驗）？這對 CDMO 的供應商管理策略有什麼意涵？
blocks.en: Why are inspectors more likely to ask for CMO audit reports in a remote inspection (compared with an on-site inspection)? What does this imply for a CDMO's supplier management strategy?

blocks.zh: Topic D.3 — Sample Collection（樣品採集）
blocks.en: Topic D.3 - Sample Collection

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 遠端查驗中的樣品請求：罕見但需備案
blocks.en: Key Point - Sample Requests in Remote Inspections: Rare but Needing a Plan

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 明確指出，遠端查驗中查驗官索取實體樣品的情況極為罕見（unlikely），因為：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote states explicitly that it is highly unlikely for inspectors to request physical samples during a remote inspection, because:

blocks.zh: 查驗官通常堅持親自參與採樣過程，以確保樣品代表性和鏈條監管（chain of custody）
blocks.en: Inspectors usually insist on being present in person during sampling to ensure sample representativeness and chain of custody

blocks.zh: 歐洲慣例中，查驗官採樣本就不是標準程序（not standard in Europe）
blocks.en: Sampling by inspectors is not standard in Europe in any case (not standard in Europe)

blocks.zh: 遠端情境下，查驗官無法確認採樣的中立性（無法排除選擇性採樣的疑慮）
blocks.en: In a remote setting, the inspector cannot confirm the neutrality of the sampling (the concern of selective sampling cannot be excluded)

blocks.zh: 但「不太可能」不代表「不會發生」。建議公司預先制定樣品索取應對方案（sample request contingency plan），包含：
blocks.en: But "unlikely" does not mean "will not happen." We recommend that companies prepare a sample request contingency plan in advance, including:

blocks.zh: 法務諮詢啟動條件與聯絡流程
blocks.en: Trigger conditions and contact process for engaging legal counsel

blocks.zh: 鏈條監管（chain of custody）文件格式
blocks.en: Chain of custody documentation format

blocks.zh: 進出口規定的簡要確認（法規專員預先完成研究）
blocks.en: A brief check of import/export rules (research completed in advance by a regulatory affairs specialist)

blocks.zh: 樣品包裝、運輸（冷鏈或常溫）及追蹤標準
blocks.en: Standards for sample packaging, transport (cold chain or ambient) and tracking

blocks.zh: 特別注意：即使是「不同意提供樣品」的決定，也必須先諮詢法務，避免直接拒絕引發衝突。
blocks.en: Special note: even a decision to "decline to provide samples" must first be discussed with Legal, to avoid a direct refusal causing conflict.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Chain of Custody 如同法庭物證保管鏈
blocks.en: Analogy - Chain of Custody Is Like the Custody Chain of Evidence in Court

blocks.zh: 刑事訴訟中，物證從犯罪現場到法庭的每一個移交環節都必須有完整記錄，任何環節的中斷都可能使物證失效。藥品樣品的鏈條監管（chain of custody）道理相同。
blocks.en: In criminal proceedings, every transfer of physical evidence from the crime scene to the courtroom must be fully documented, and a break at any step can invalidate the evidence. The chain of custody for drug samples works on the same principle.

blocks.zh: 若查驗官要求採樣但無法親自在場，任何採樣、包裝、運輸、接收環節都必須有文件記錄並由雙方確認——否則樣品的代表性和未受污染性將無法被第三方認證，導致樣品分析結果在法規層面失去效力。
blocks.en: If the inspector asks for sampling but cannot be present in person, every step of sampling, packaging, transport and receipt must be documented and confirmed by both parties; otherwise the representativeness and freedom from contamination of the sample cannot be certified by a third party, and the analytical results lose their validity from a regulatory standpoint.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 進出口規定對樣品運輸的影響
blocks.en: Core Concept - Impact of Import/Export Rules on Sample Shipment

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 提醒：樣品運輸適用進出口規定（import/export rules）。這在跨國遠端查驗時尤為重要：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote reminds that sample shipment is subject to import/export rules. This is particularly important in cross-border remote inspections:

blocks.zh: 生物製品（biologics）：可能需要 CITES 許可或雙邊進出口授權
blocks.en: Biologics: may require a CITES permit or bilateral import/export authorization

blocks.zh: 含有管制成分的產品：需要麻醉藥品主管機關的特別許可
blocks.en: Products containing controlled substances: require special permission from the narcotics control authority

blocks.zh: 冷鏈樣品：需確認目的地國家接收方具備適當儲存條件和接收能力
blocks.en: Cold chain samples: confirm that the receiver in the destination country has suitable storage conditions and receiving capability

blocks.zh: 部分台灣出口藥品樣品：可能需要食藥署出口許可
blocks.en: Some drug samples exported from Taiwan: may require an export permit from the Taiwan FDA

blocks.zh: 建議在收到樣品索取請求後，立即啟動進出口規定確認程序，避免因行政障礙導致不必要的查驗延誤。
blocks.en: We recommend starting the import/export rule check immediately after receiving a sample request, to avoid unnecessary inspection delays caused by administrative obstacles.

blocks.zh: 歐洲 EMA 查驗官在虛擬視廠過程中，透過視訊看到生產線上有疑似異物的瓶子，要求公司採樣並寄送樣品供分析。你應如何回應？法務在何時介入？
blocks.en: During a virtual site tour, an EMA inspector in Europe sees via video a bottle on the production line with a suspected foreign particle and asks the company to take a sample and ship it for analysis. How should you respond? When does Legal become involved?

blocks.zh: 為什麼遠端查驗中「chain of custody（鏈條監管）」的管理難度比現場查驗更高？公司可以採取哪些措施來降低風險？
blocks.en: Why is managing chain of custody harder in a remote inspection than in an on-site inspection? What measures can the company take to reduce the risk?

blocks.zh: Topic E.1 — Use of Daily or Intermediate Wrap-ups（每日或中間收尾會議的運用）
blocks.en: Topic E.1 - Use of Daily or Intermediate Wrap-ups

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 每日收尾會議是降低遠端溝通誤差的最重要工具
blocks.en: Key Point - The Daily Wrap-up Is the Most Important Tool for Reducing Remote Communication Errors

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 明確指出：遠端查驗的溝通誤差風險高於現場查驗（risks related to miscommunication are higher during remote inspections）。這是因為：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote states explicitly that the risk of miscommunication is higher in remote inspections than in on-site inspections (risks related to miscommunication are higher during remote inspections). This is because:

blocks.zh: 查驗官無法透過肢體語言、表情或環境氛圍判斷現場理解程度
blocks.en: Inspectors cannot judge the level of understanding on site from body language, facial expressions or the atmosphere

blocks.zh: 文件索取透過多個數位管道傳遞，容易遺漏或誤解
blocks.en: Document requests travel through several digital channels and are easily missed or misunderstood

blocks.zh: 跨時區查驗可能導致確認回路（confirmation loop）時間拉長
blocks.en: Cross-time-zone inspections can lengthen the confirmation loop

blocks.zh: 多工作流並行時，查驗官的關注重心可能在公司不知情的情況下已轉移
blocks.en: With several workstreams running in parallel, the inspector's focus may shift without the company being aware

blocks.zh: 關鍵行動：即使查驗官沒有主動提議，公司應主動、每日提出 wrap-up 請求。不要等查驗官來問——主動提議體現了查驗紀律，也有助建立信任關係。
blocks.en: Key action: even if the inspector does not propose it, the company should proactively request a wrap-up every day. Do not wait for the inspector to ask: proposing it proactively demonstrates inspection discipline and helps build a trusting relationship.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 每日收尾會議如同遠端施工的每日進度確認
blocks.en: Analogy - The Daily Wrap-up Is Like a Daily Progress Check on a Remote Construction Project

blocks.zh: 想像一個大型建設工地的業主（公司）委託承包商（查驗官）進行遠端驗收。如果業主沒有每日與驗收員確認「今天看了哪些、發現什麼問題、明天看哪些」，到最後驗收結束才發現業主以為已經通過的項目其實查驗官還有疑問——這時修正已為時已晚。
blocks.en: Imagine the owner of a large construction site (the company) having a contractor (the inspector) carry out remote acceptance. If the owner does not confirm with the acceptance officer each day what was reviewed today, what issues were found and what will be reviewed tomorrow, then only when acceptance ends does the owner discover that items assumed to have passed still raised questions for the inspector, and by then it is too late to correct them.

blocks.zh: 每日 wrap-up 就是每日進度確認電話：確保雙方對「今天完成了什麼、有哪些懸而未決、明天的計畫」有共同認知（共識對齊，alignment）。
blocks.en: The daily wrap-up is that daily progress call: it ensures both sides share the same understanding (alignment) of what was completed today, what remains open and tomorrow's plan.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 查驗焦點轉移（Focus Shift）的即時溝通義務
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Obligation to Communicate Focus Shifts in Real Time

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-Remote 要求查驗官在轉換查驗關注點時應即時告知（promptly communicate any shift in focus）。這在遠端查驗中具有特別重要的意義：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-Remote expects inspectors to promptly communicate any shift in focus. This is especially important in remote inspections:

blocks.zh: 現場查驗中，查驗官走進另一個房間就是焦點轉移的視覺信號；但在遠端查驗中，查驗官在多個文件窗口之間切換時，公司人員可能渾然不知，繼續準備舊主題的文件，浪費時間與資源。
blocks.en: In an on-site inspection, an inspector walking into another room is a visual signal of a focus shift; in a remote inspection, while the inspector switches between several document windows, company staff may be completely unaware and keep preparing documents for the old topic, wasting time and resources.

blocks.zh: 建議公司在 wrap-up 會議或即時 chat 中主動詢問：「查驗官，您目前對哪個主題最有興趣？我們希望確保資源安排符合您的需求。」這不是引導查驗方向，而是提高效率的專業做法。
blocks.en: We recommend that the company proactively ask during the wrap-up meeting or in real-time chat: "Inspector, which topic are you most interested in at the moment? We want to make sure our resource planning meets your needs." This is not steering the inspection; it is a professional practice that improves efficiency.

blocks.zh: 查驗官表示「我不需要每日 wrap-up，有問題我會直接提」。作為 Lead Remote Inspection Host，你會如何回應？為什麼 PDA PtC-Remote 建議即使查驗官不主動要求，也應堅持每日 wrap-up？
blocks.en: An inspector says, "I don't need a daily wrap-up; I'll raise questions directly." As Lead Remote Inspection Host, how would you respond? Why does PDA PtC-Remote recommend insisting on a daily wrap-up even if the inspector does not ask for one?

blocks.zh: 查驗第三天，你注意到查驗官的問題突然從品質系統轉向生產偏差紀錄，但沒有預先告知。你應該如何處理這個焦點轉移？
blocks.en: On day three of the inspection, you notice that the inspector's questions have suddenly moved from the quality system to production deviation records without any advance notice. How should you handle this focus shift?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 每日收尾會議標準議程（3–5 分鐘）
blocks.en: Practical Application - Standard Daily Wrap-up Agenda (3-5 Minutes)

blocks.zh: 建議公司準備標準化的 wrap-up 議程範本，每日由 Lead Remote Inspection Host 主持，時間控制在 3–5 分鐘：
blocks.en: We recommend that companies prepare a standardized wrap-up agenda template, chaired each day by the Lead Remote Inspection Host and kept to 3-5 minutes:

blocks.zh: 此議程可直接在每日查驗結束前 15 分鐘發送給查驗官，作為提議 wrap-up 的邀請方式，同時也顯示公司的查驗管理成熟度。
blocks.en: This agenda can be sent to the inspector 15 minutes before the end of each inspection day as the invitation to hold the wrap-up, and it also shows the maturity of the company's inspection management.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Part II: Remote Inspection Realization
blocks.en: Section Summary - Part II: Remote Inspection Realization

blocks.zh: Topic A.1：遠端查驗全日使用單一視訊連結；設立虛擬候診室管控人員進出；所有問題（口頭+書面）均需記錄於集中問題 log；溝通只限於雙方事先同意的平台，不得使用 SMS/WhatsApp 等非正式管道
blocks.en: Topic A.1: Use a single video link for the whole remote inspection day; set up a virtual waiting room to control who enters and leaves; record all questions (verbal and written) in a centralized question log; communicate only through platforms agreed in advance by both parties, and do not use informal channels such as SMS/WhatsApp

blocks.zh: Topic B.1：多查驗官同時作業時，為每個工作流指派專屬 Remote Inspection Host 和獨立視訊連結；問題 log 必須對所有 Host 可見，確保無重複請求
blocks.en: Topic B.1: When multiple inspectors work at the same time, assign a dedicated Remote Inspection Host and a separate video link to each workstream; the question log must be visible to all Hosts to ensure no duplicate requests

blocks.zh: Topic C.1：查驗官不得直接存取 GMP/GDP 系統（LIMS、BMS 等）；正確方式為站點受訓專家代為登入並螢幕共享；拒絕直接存取不等於拒絕接受查驗，需事先準備標準說明措辭
blocks.en: Topic C.1: Inspectors must not directly access GMP/GDP systems (LIMS, BMS, etc.); the correct approach is for trained site experts to log in on their behalf and share the screen; declining direct access is not the same as refusing the inspection, and standard wording should be prepared in advance

blocks.zh: Topic D.1：回應速度應盡快且符合現場運作；預先建立法務諮詢策略，涵蓋人員影像請求、錄影請求、必須拒絕的請求三類情境；可分批傳送大型電子文件
blocks.en: Topic D.1: Respond as quickly as possible, consistent with site operations; establish a legal consultation strategy in advance covering three scenarios (requests for images of personnel, recording requests, and requests that must be declined); large electronic documents may be sent in batches

blocks.zh: Topic D.2：CMO/供應商稽核報告可透過螢幕共享或文件攝影機呈現封面與結論；分享完整報告前應確認品質協議條款並通知 CMO/供應商；未來所有品質協議應加入報告分享授權條款
blocks.en: Topic D.2: CMO/supplier audit reports can be presented via screen-sharing or document camera, showing the cover page and conclusions; before sharing the full report, check the Quality Agreement clause and notify the CMO/supplier; all future Quality Agreements should include a report-sharing authorization clause

blocks.zh: Topic D.3：遠端查驗中樣品索取請求極為罕見；若發生應先諮詢法務再決定同意或拒絕；需注意鏈條監管（chain of custody）管理與進出口規定
blocks.en: Topic D.3: Sample requests in remote inspections are extremely rare; if one occurs, consult Legal first before deciding to agree or decline; pay attention to chain of custody management and import/export rules

blocks.zh: Topic E.1：每日收尾會議（wrap-up）應主動要求，即使查驗官未提出；3–5 分鐘標準議程確保雙方對齊未結事項與次日計畫；遠端查驗的溝通誤差風險高於現場，wrap-up 是最有效的緩解工具
blocks.en: Topic E.1: Proactively request the daily wrap-up even if the inspector does not propose it; a 3-5 minute standard agenda ensures both sides are aligned on open items and the next day's plan; the risk of miscommunication is higher in remote than on-site inspections, and the wrap-up is the most effective mitigation tool
